sections.title: IHE IT Infrastructure Technical Framework Supplement — Verifiable Health Links (VHL)
Overview and Bibliographic Identity
sections.extract: The IHE IT Infrastructure Technical Framework Supplement: Verifiable Health Links (VHL) specifies actors, transactions, and trust-list interactions for issuing, presenting, verifying, and redeeming cryptographically verifiable links to health documents and FHIR resources across organizational and jurisdictional boundaries. sections.title: Trust-Anchor Neutrality
sections.extract: IHE VHL is trust-anchor neutral by design. The Trust Anchor actor represents any trust framework authority capable of accepting PKI material ([ITI-YY1]) and distributing verifiable trust lists ([ITI-YY2]).
